visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with wavy reddish-brown hair stands in a bright white hallway in front of a white elevator door. She is wearing a floral print sleeveless maxi dress layered under a long white open-knit vest. She speaks animatedly to the camera while holding a brown leather shoulder bag. (2) The woman presses the elevator button, and as the white doors slide open, a dark interior shimmering with thousands of tiny white LED lights is revealed, resembling a starlit night. She steps inside with a surprised and delighted expression, looking around at the sparkling walls. (3) The scene transitions to a grand golden lobby with floor-to-ceiling metallic gold chain curtains. A staff member in a black suit stands to the side and performs a traditional Thai bow. The woman walks through the golden curtains, her reflection visible on the polished, mirrored floors. (4) Inside a high-end elevator with gold-leafed walls and large mirrors, the woman sits on a sculpted golden dog statue that serves as a seat. She points out several silver metallic spheres rolling on the floor. Her companions and other passengers are briefly visible in the mirror reflections. (5) The woman enters a bright, modern cafe with a minimalist white interior and large floor-to-ceiling windows. The Bangkok city skyline is visible outside, featuring the iconic pixelated MahaNakhon building. Several customers are seated on white stools along a long counter overlooking the urban landscape. (6) Seated by the window, the woman holds a light brown paper cup featuring a black "%" logo. She points toward the city view while talking about the coffee. She takes a sip, closes her eyes in enjoyment, and gives a thumbs-up gesture to the camera.
